title: Lucky Thirteen Original Voodoo Berry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Voodoo Berry from Lucky Thirteen’s Original Collection is a deliciously sweet and juicy Mixed Berry blend with delicately sharp notes and rich, jammy depth. This product contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml shortfill bottle, with space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots to let you tailor your e juice’s nicotine content. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. The e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vaping mods and sub-ohm tanks , producing rich clouds and immaculate flavour.
